input.quote: 7.2 The O&M Costs as defined in Paragraph 6 shall be borne by the Parties in the proportions set forth in Schedule B.
input.rationale: Subparagraphs 7.1 and 7.2 bind us to bear our Schedule B share of Capital Costs and O&M Costs, and Subparagraph 18.1 locks that funding obligation in for an initial period of at least twenty-five (25) years, terminable only \"at the end of the Initial Period or any time thereafter by giving not less than one (1) year's prior notice\", with \"No credit for capital costs\" on exit; non-payment is met by reclamation of our capacity under Subparagraph 23.1 with no payment, credit or reimbursement. That is a multi-year, uncapped spend commitment with no in-term reduction right and a forfeiture-style consequence, i.e. walk-away territory. The upgrade protections in 13.2/14.1 (\"no Party shall be forced to participate in such an upgrade\") cover only upgrades, not the recurring O&M commitment, and Subparagraph 7.7 is only a one-off Capital Costs settlement after the RFS Date, so it is not a shortfall true-up. We therefore take the fallback with one inserted Subparagraph 7.2A: our O&M commitment is confined to the then-current twelve (12) month period measured from the RFS Date, reducible on thirty (30) days' notice, and any reduction or shortfall is settled by paying our proportionate share of O&M Costs actually incurred, trued up to actual cost, with no penalty, forfeiture, reclamation of capacity or acceleration. We do not claim the preferred level, which would require abandoning Schedule B proportionate cost-bearing altogether.

mappings.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.

proposal.summary: Insert Subparagraph 7.2A: our O&M commitment limited to successive 12-month periods from the RFS Date, reducible on 30 days' notice, with actual-cost true-up and no penalty or reclamation
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot take a 25-year, uncapped O&M funding commitment with no exit, so we have added Subparagraph 7.2A limiting Teleglobe USA Inc.'s O&M Costs commitment to the then-current twelve (12) month period from the RFS Date, reducible on thirty (30) days' notice, with any reduction or shortfall settled by a true-up to O&M Costs actually incurred rather than any penalty, forfeiture, reclamation of capacity or acceleration.

ops.text: Teleglobe USA Inc.'s commitment to bear O&M Costs under Subparagraph 7.2 is limited to the then-current twelve (12) month period, such periods commencing on the RFS Date and each anniversary of it, and may be reduced by Teleglobe USA Inc. on thirty (30) days' prior written notice. On any such reduction or any shortfall against that commitment, Teleglobe USA Inc. shall pay only its proportionate share of O&M Costs actually incurred for the period concerned, trued up to actual cost, and no penalty, forfeiture, reclamation of capacity or acceleration shall apply in respect of the reduced amount.
